scope: Canonical conventions for current controlled calculations. Branch-specific deviations require explicit rederivation.

HZT-M0-P5.rule: No S6 equation may be transferred without explicit reduction and sign audit.

HZT-Full.rule: Examples are not adopted conventions. The physical signature, constraints and inner product remain open.

metric_and_curvature.levi_civita_connection: Gamma^A_BC = 1/2 g^{AD}(partial_B g_DC + partial_C g_DB - partial_D g_BC)
metric_and_curvature.riemann: R^A_BCD = partial_C Gamma^A_DB - partial_D Gamma^A_CB + Gamma^A_CE Gamma^E_DB - Gamma^A_DE Gamma^E_CB
metric_and_curvature.warning: Every imported source must be converted to this sign convention before comparison.

gravity.einstein_hilbert_action: S_EH = (1/(2 kappa_6^2)) integral d^6X sqrt(|g_6|) (R_6 - 2 Lambda_6)
gravity.boundary_rule: The appropriate Gibbons-Hawking-York and cap/brane boundary terms must be included before variation.

minisuperspace.line_element: ds_6^2 = -N(t)^2 dt^2 + a(t)^2 gamma_ij dx^i dx^j + b(t)^2 h_mn dy^m dy^n
minisuperspace.kinetic_combination: K_IJ K^IJ - K^2 = -6 H_a^2 - 12 H_a H_b - 2 H_b^2
minisuperspace.gauge_rule: N may be set to one only after delta S / delta N = 0 has been derived.

fields.yang_mills_field_strength: F^a_AB = partial_A A^a_B - partial_B A^a_A + f^a_bc A^b_A A^c_B

four_dimensional_reduction.validity_condition: E, H, k/a much smaller than m_radion and m_KK
four_dimensional_reduction.warning: Warping, localized profiles and nonlocal bulk response modify these relations.

stability_vocabulary.ghost: negative eigenvalue of the reduced physical kinetic matrix after constraint elimination
stability_vocabulary.gradient_instability: negative physical squared propagation speed in the relevant regime
stability_vocabulary.tachyon: negative physical mass squared outside an explicitly allowed instability timescale
stability_vocabulary.strong_coupling: canonical normalization lowers the interaction cutoff to or below the claimed regime of validity

status_vocabulary.DERIVED: Analytically follows from the stated action and assumptions.
status_vocabulary.CONDITIONAL: Follows only after an explicitly named additional assumption.
status_vocabulary.DIAGNOSTIC: Useful for numerical or algebraic QA; no evidence effect.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: The precisely tested mechanism fails a stated gate.
status_vocabulary.REJECTED: The precisely defined branch is excluded within its assumptions.
status_vocabulary.QUARANTINED: May be stress-tested but cannot feed physical claims.
status_vocabulary.NOT_RELEASED: Required bridge has not passed its release criteria.
status_vocabulary.NOT_ADMISSIBLE: Likelihood/evidence interpretation is forbidden at the current gate.

numerical_rules: Every input and output carries units or an explicit dimensionless declaration.
Every solver includes analytic limits and regression reference values.
Every ODE solver includes step-size convergence or adaptive error control.
Every generalized eigenproblem reports conditioning and norm definiteness.
Failure states are explicit and never silently converted to finite outputs.
A stable numerical result has no evidence effect without a released physical map.
transfer_rule: No formula, spectrum, sign, degree-of-freedom count or observable map may be transferred between S6, P5 and HZT-Full without explicit rederivation under the target signature, boundary conditions and constraint algebra.
